name: Owner setup and session lifecycle
requires: Fresh isolated installation; synthetic local account
assertions: Setup is possible only before the first Owner exists
Session cookies and CSRF tokens follow the authenticated session
Logout invalidates the previous session

name: Invitation and immediate access revocation
requires: Owner session and two Properties with Homes
assertions: Execute the grant reads as the invited account
Property, Home and area grants restrict all nested references
Removing access takes effect on an existing cookie
negativeCases: Remove or demote the last Owner

name: Property without a Home
requires: Owner session; no Home attached to the new Property
assertions: Property-owned records work without a Home
All saved records retain the Property owner
Filters return only the selected Property
negativeCases: Missing Property and Home on maintenance creation

name: Home layout and sensor lifecycle
requires: Property with two Homes; synthetic layouts and sensor IDs
assertions: Capture created Home and sensor IDs for later requests
Stable roomId relationships survive room label changes
A deleted sensor is absent from active lists

name: Hide Home and preserve Property history
requires: Home with readings, sensors, a connection, Property notes, equipment and maintenance
assertions: Reads and new writes to the hidden Home fail closed
Property-owned records remain editable and retain their hidden Home reference
Archived credentials never attach to another Home
negativeCases: Indirect access through analytics, streams or nested IDs

name: Area equipment attachments and links
requires: Property and area; harmless synthetic document/image bytes
assertions: Nested attachment/link IDs cannot be substituted between equipment records
Downloads preserve content and safe response headers
Deletion has the documented effect on dependent records

name: Property notes and optimistic observations
requires: Property, Home, floor and optional sensor
assertions: Use the latest baseRevision for each edit
Resolve/reopen timestamps are server-owned
Stale edits do not change the record or its revision

name: Maintenance planning through verification
requires: Property-owned task and optional Home observation evidence
assertions: Exercise planned, in-progress, completed and verified using successive current revisions
Completion requires completionNote; verification requires verificationNote
Completion and verification times are assigned by the server

name: Legacy readings and compatibility aliases
requires: Home and sensor; fixed synthetic time window
assertions: Repeat for single reading, array and readings wrapper
Compare canonical and compatibility projections
Stream events contain only visible scope

name: Measurement registry and sparse ingestion
requires: Home and sensor; fake custom measurement definition
assertions: Repeat each documented ingestion wrapper
Sparse samples preserve per-metric units, quality, source and event time
Test each definition kind and its supported aggregations/forecast behavior

name: Analytics coverage and query combinations
requires: Home with synthetic good, estimated and stale measurements
assertions: Cross live/demo, measurement kind, aggregation, resolution, quality filter and range
Compare bounded raw and rollup output against seeded data
Read-only POSTs work with the documented Guest grant

name: Calendar comparison and opening activity
requires: Synthetic multi-year readings and opening-state observations
assertions: Cross day/week/month/year/decade with both data modes and supported aggregations
Check month/year boundaries, leap day and DST
Opening summaries preserve provenance and incomplete evidence

name: Derived analytics cache and monitoring
requires: Synthetic fresh, gapped and insufficient-evidence Homes; fake compute executor
assertions: Cross both data modes and every documented windowDays choice
Cached reads do not silently trigger expensive fresh calculations
Pending, stale, failed and unsupported evidence remain explicit

name: Weather inheritance and thermal calculations
requires: Property weather location and optional Home override; fake weather provider
assertions: Home inherits Property location until an override is configured
Fresh/stale/unavailable snapshots preserve provenance
Historical weather and simulation use the requested Home and range
negativeCases: Location changed while fetch is pending

name: Property electricity and Home consumption
requires: Property with Homes/meters; fake public price source
assertions: Contract ownership stays on the Property
Home price response contains only its allowed projection
Costs match independently seeded meter/price intervals
negativeCases: Private network or credential-bearing price URL

name: Alert rules events and delivery retries
requires: Synthetic sensor and fake Telegram/APNs/webhook transports
assertions: Exercise trigger, acknowledge, resolve and duplicate-evidence states
Delivery attempts and retry history remain scoped
Aliases reflect the same underlying alert

name: Action playbooks and runs
requires: Home sensor and optional alert event
assertions: Completion and cancellation produce the documented terminal states
Evidence and alert references belong to the run's Home

name: Apple notification registration ownership
requires: Synthetic local account/device ID and fake APNs transport
assertions: Self-service Guest exceptions preserve device/account ownership
Subscriptions include only granted Homes
Revocation and provider-invalid tokens stop delivery

name: Discovery jobs and sensor mapping
requires: Fake discovery and integration clients; Home with unmapped sensors
assertions: Poll and stream agree on job progress/results
Bulk mappings retain Home ownership
Partial discovery does not invent healthy connections

name: Home Assistant connection lifecycle
requires: Two Homes and fake Home Assistant service; temporary secrets file
assertions: Draft testing does not persist configuration
Secrets never appear in setup/status responses
Moving/disconnecting preserves the documented Home and credential lifecycle

name: TP-Link connection and credential reuse
requires: Two Homes and fake TP-Link hubs/sockets; temporary secrets file
assertions: Cross fresh username/password and saved credentialSourceConnectionId branches
Each connection belongs to one Home
Returned setup/device data excludes stored secrets

name: Tapo history worker queue
requires: Fake Tapo exporter/mailbox, synthetic history, scoped worker token
assertions: Approved canary gates eligible backfill
Only the claiming worker may heartbeat/update its job
Imported history preserves immutable lineage

name: Telegram pairing and test delivery
requires: Fake Telegram client and synthetic bot/chat identifiers
assertions: Only the configured Workspace destination receives a test
Bot credentials and raw private chat identifiers are redacted from public status

name: Apple Notes grant capture and deduplication
requires: Home and temporary protected grants store
assertions: The bearer is returned only once
Identical operationId/payload deduplicates as documented
Revocation denies subsequent requests
negativeCases: General browser cookie used as grant

name: Gree local and cloud heat pump placement
requires: Fake Gree LAN/cloud transports and Home layout
assertions: Repeat for local and cloud connections
Placement belongs to the selected Home/floor
History preserves source and freshness

name: Tuya device configuration and control
requires: Fake Tuya LAN client and explicitly controllable simulated device
assertions: Only advertised device capabilities accept commands
Placement and control preserve Home scope
Use simulated actuators for every command

name: Nexus433 candidate binding and recovery
requires: Fake MQTT receiver, synthetic candidate and Home sensor
assertions: Candidate binding is explicit and scoped
Reconnect cannot silently change sensor identity
Stale receiver state remains visible

name: Tracking enrollment evidence and map stream
requires: Tracking enabled; synthetic endpoint, observer, equipment and clock
assertions: Position estimates include freshness and uncertainty
Observer credentials are route- and installation-scoped
Map events are ordered and scoped

name: Equipment borrowing and explicit presence
requires: Property, equipment and granted synthetic member
assertions: Borrow/return records preserve member and Property scope
Presence is explicit, current and accuracy-labelled
Stopping or expiring presence removes the current location

name: Spatial layer configuration and inference
requires: Fake optional inference engine, synthetic frames/zones and Home sensors
assertions: Cross enabled/disabled engine, local scope, mode and layer choices
Bindings/calibrations have valid related frames and zones
Optional inference cannot mutate core climate state

name: Stuguby collaboration and grant revocation
requires: Two isolated fake nodes/coordinator and synthetic shared Property/Home
assertions: Default remote Home projection is read-only
Grant changes apply to telemetry, layout and blobs
Detach purges the remote cache using the documented receipt workflow

name: Stuguby signed protocol replay and blobs
requires: Fake node identities generated only in test fixtures; simulated peer transport
assertions: Sign the exact method/path/body and required protocol headers
Replay request IDs and stale timestamps are rejected
Digest, access and deletion receipts protect blobs

name: Exports schedules and backup requests
requires: Synthetic Home data, fake NAS/export/backup agents and temporary output directory
assertions: Cross documented formats, privacy levels, scopes and schedule choices
Preview agrees with exported scope
Exports remain Home-owned and destinations installation-owned

name: Demo and replay isolation
requires: Synthetic historical readings and controllable clock
assertions: Cross every advertised scenario and supported replay speed/range
Demo/replay never overwrite live source evidence
Stopping replay restores the documented mode

name: System updates with simulated host agent
requires: Injected fake release feed/update agent; never a real appliance
assertions: Cross every documented action branch and allowed channel
Expected revision, generation, digest and confirmation are enforced
Simulate unsupported safety state, staged/active workflow, failure and recovery

name: Storage and host monitoring
requires: Fake host/storage services; no real mount or migration
assertions: Owner/Admin guards protect administrative output
The configured ingest credential grants only its metrics exception
Unsupported or missing host evidence remains explicit

name: MCP runtime and HTTP transport
requires: Fake/local isolated MCP runtime and synthetic bearer
assertions: Exercise JSON-RPC initialization, notification, tool list and permitted tool calls
A stopped/restarted runtime invalidates old access credentials
Browser-origin transport requests are denied

name: Cloudflare setup callback and one-time claim
requires: Fake OAuth/cloud provisioning service and synthetic one-time state
assertions: Callback state and claim are single-use and expire
Operator credentials stay outside source and public responses
All provisioning effects use mocks

name: Bug report configuration relay and failure recovery
requires: Fake relay and GitHub transport; synthetic report only
assertions: Use relay:submitReport as the downstream leg or as an independent relay test, not a duplicate real submission
Application response omits private repository/issue URLs
The shared token is never returned by configuration reads

name: Static parameters assets and Apple RoomPlan
requires: Home and floor; synthetic parameter, asset and RoomPlan export
assertions: Canonical and compatibility parameter routes share the documented state
Asset media and references remain safe and scoped
RoomPlan import preserves stable layout relationships
